### SetParamsWithStruct

**SetParamsWithStruct** sets multiple query parameters from a struct. Each exported field becomes a parameter named by its `param` struct tag, or by the field name when it has no tag. Nested structs are not supported; see [SetValWithStruct](#setvalwithstruct) for the field types that are used.

```go title="Signature"
func (r *Request) SetParamsWithStruct(v any) *Request
```

<details>
<summary>Example</summary>

```go title="Example"
req := client.AcquireRequest()
defer client.ReleaseRequest(req)

req.SetParamsWithStruct(struct {
    Name    string   `param:"name"`
    Hobbies []string `param:"hobbies"`
}{
    Name: "John Doe",
    Hobbies: []string{
        "Football",
        "Basketball",
    },
})

resp, err := req.Get("https://httpbin.org/response-headers")
if err != nil {
    panic(err)
}

fmt.Println(string(resp.Body()))
```

```json
{
  "Content-Length": "147", 
  "Content-Type": "application/json", 
  "hobbies": [
    "Football", 
    "Basketball"
  ], 
  "name": "John Doe"
}
```

</details>

### SetParamsWithStruct

Sets multiple query parameters from a struct. Each field is named by its `param` struct tag, or by the field name when it has none. Nested structs are not currently supported. See [SetValWithStruct](./request.md#setvalwithstruct) for the supported field types.

```go title="Signature"
func (c *Client) SetParamsWithStruct(v any) *Client
```
